newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian STUMETAL offers to buy minority shares.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian STUMETAL offers to buy minority shares.

text.p: Tunisia's packaging firm STUMETAL's majority owner has been authorised to purchase the shares held by minority shareholders, the Conseil du Marche Financier (CMF), the Tunis Stock Exchange watching body, said on Thursday.
Groupe Salah Mokdad, which has 99.998 percent of STUMETAL's capital, was authorised to launch a public offer to redeem the outstanding 0.002 percent of the shares, the CMF said.
STUMETAL, one of the first Tunisian firms to be privatised, was sold to private investors for about $8.5 million in 1990.
French packaging manufacturer Carnaud gained a minority stake in STUMETAL when it was privatised but later sold its stake to Tunisian businessman Mokdad.
